name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
summary: Someone directs you to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp. His camp lies north of the Alterac Mountains.

sections.title: A Camp in the North
sections.body: Chillwind Camp is where you are sent to find Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp lies north of the Alterac Mountains, and he is the one you are asked to seek out.

faq.q: Who am I supposed to find?
faq.answer: You are sent to find Commander Ashlam Valorfist.
Commander Ashlam Valorfist's base camp is at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.
Chillwind Camp is north of the Alterac Mountains.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
